title_kh: សម្ល និង ស្ងោរ
summary_en: Khmer soup dishes including samlor (brothy soups with meat, fish, and vegetables) and sngor (lighter broths). In Khmer cookbooks, sngor is grouped with samlor. Techniques cover simmering, seasoning with fish sauce, and adding herbs at the end.
